Contract ManageUserCRUDService::modifyUser(userid: Integer,name: String,address: String): Boolean {
	definition:
		user: User = User.allInstance()->any(u|u.UserID = userid),
		card: BankCard = user.OwnedCard
	precondition:
		user.oclIsUndefined() = false and
		card.oclIsUndefined() = false
	postcondition:
		card.oclIsUndefined() = false and
		card.CardID = self.cardID and
		card.CardStatus = self.cardStatus and
		card.Catalog = self.catalog and
		card.Password = self.password and
		card.Balance = self.balance and
		result = true
}
